title: SafeCap: Improving LVLM Safety with Image Captioning Reinforcement Learning
abstract: Large vision-language models (LVLMs) remain vulnerable to jailbreak attacks that exploit visual inputs to bypass safety alignment inherited from their language backbones. title: MindTopo reveals VLMs’ spatial reasoning abilities
abstract:
A path, a fence, a knot. MindTopo sets a new benchmark for testing how AI understands topological relationships and  highlights new opportunities to strengthen spatial reasoning and planning.
The post MindTopo reveals VLMs’ spatial reasoning abilities appeared first on Microsoft Research.
